verdict.rationale: telli is an AI voice-agent platform, so handling barge-in is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers interruption handling, stopping speech mid-utterance, updating context after an interruption, or recovering the turn. The available items cover scheduling, webhooks, tools, testing and voice cloning, none of which concern turn-taking.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on the agent to handle interruptions (barge-in) gracefully — stopping speech, updating context, and recovering the turn
